title: Rescission and Funding Dispute Timeframes for Every Closing and Funding Method
content:
The Closing and Funding product applies one set of rescission and funding dispute timeframes to every closing method (the Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing, Escrow Dry-Funding Closing, Mobile Notary Closing, Hybrid eClosing, Remote Online Notarization Closing, Power of Attorney Closing and Mail-Away Closing).

## Right of rescission

| Term | Value under every closing method |
|---|---|
| Length of the right of rescission | 3 specific business days |
| Loan purposes that carry the right on a primary residence | rate-and-term refinance, cash-out refinance |
| Occupancy that carries the right | primary residence |
| First day funds may be wired | 1 calendar day after the rescission expiration date |
| A rescission waiver needs the borrower's dated, signed statement of a bona fide personal financial emergency | Yes |

## Funding disputes

| Term | Value under every closing method |
|---|---|
| Window to file a funding dispute | 60 calendar days after the disbursement date |
| Acknowledgment of a funding dispute | within 5 business days |
| Decision on a funding dispute | within 30 business days |

## Reading the figures

- A purchase carries no rescission period, whatever the occupancy; a rate-and-term or cash-out refinance of a primary residence does.
- Hypothetical: a loan disbursed on 1 June has a dispute window that runs 60 calendar days, counting 1 June as day zero, so the last day of the window is 31 July.
